key_insights: 20k is the 2017 ATH and represents the 'best level on the chart' for BTC - strongest support level available
Playing for mean reversion to 30k+ area on BTC and 2k on ETH, not necessarily a new bull market trend
Two main risks to the bullish thesis: (1) 200-week moving average acting as resistance from underside, (2) Macro contagion from S&P 500 if stocks nuke
FTX/CEX exchange committing $2B+ to backstop industry, signaling worst of the liquidity crunch is likely over
Crypto-specific forced selling (3AC, Celsius, etc.) appears largely complete, removing supply overhang
Miners selling inventory during bear markets has historically been a bottom indicator
S&P 500 showing confluence with BTC - both at monthly support and showing improved price action
Duck's personal worst case for BTC is 14k, making 20k entry attractive with 60k+ upside potential
Altcoins expected to lag BTC initially but outperform near the top of the move
summary: Cred and Duck are strongly bullish on BTC and ETH at 20k and 900-1000 levels respectively, viewing them as key support areas (2017 ATH for BTC, previous cycle level for ETH). Both are playing for mean reversion to 30k+ on BTC and 2k on ETH, citing the liquidity crunch and forced selling as largely over. Main risks are 200-week MA resistance and macro contagion. Duck mentions he's up 30% on SOL. Both agree altcoins will lag BTC initially but may outperform near the top.
